name: Global L45 Sorcerer - first-month upgrade target
notes: Upgrade path on top of the median loadout: Rupture Tome +10, Bakarma Guard +10, Aulamus accessories +10, Abyssal Bracelets +10, the best launch titles and five Unique arcana at +0.
Fixed item and enchant values come from the global client item tables (metabot.gg). Random rolls are good but realistic picks from each item's roll pool.
Deity stats = median profile averages + arcana main stats at +0 (20 each, best variant per slot) + Abyssal Bracelet deity rolls.

Arcana skill rolls: each Unique arcana gives 4 random skill levels at +0 (9 at +5) from its slot's pool; Chalice/Parchment/Compass roll actives, Bell/Mirror passives. This loadout uses one typical roll set.
